memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Benign prostatic hyperplasia with LUTS
  Status: Nocturia 2-3 times/night, weak stream, weight 78 kg, waist 92 cm (>90 cm cut-off).
  Plan: Start tamsulosin 0.4 mg at bedtime, finasteride 5 mg OD; advise fluid restriction after 18:00, double voiding.
- Asymptomatic elevated PSA? Not yet assessed.
  Status: Baseline labs pending.
  Plan: Order PSA, urine routine, ultrasound KUB with PVR.
Due: HbA1c not indicated (no glucose‑lowering therapy).

memories.text: Refer to Urology, Sakra World Hospital for elevated PSA (5.8 ng/mL) and prostate assessment. Request MRI pelvis and prostate-specific antigen trend.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Urology opinion: MRI shows benign prostatic hyperplasia, no suspicious lesions. PSA rise attributed to BPH. Recommend continue current meds, repeat PSA in 6 months, monitor symptoms.
